feeds.title: Body Image Movement Blog
feeds.description: Body Image Movement is on a mission to end the global body-hating epidemic by inspiring people to embrace their bodies through documentaries, books, online programs, speaking, and educational resources. Our strength is taking evidence-based data from health professionals and turning it into content that is educational, inspirational, engaging, and fun!

feeds.title: Jessi Kneeland Blog
feeds.description: Jessi Kneeland is a queer and non-binary writer, speaker, and body neutrality coach. Her writings revolve around the topics of body neutrality, body image, body positivity, self-acceptance, self-worth, and body liberation. Read the latest articles and book updates from Jessi in her blog.

feeds.title: GirlTalkHQ » Body Image
feeds.description: Dive into articles on Body Image and Self-love that offer enlightening insights and perspectives into the changing Body Acceptance standards and vernacular in popular culture. GirlTalkHQ is a global storytelling platform amplifying the voices of womxn, girls, and femmes.

feeds.title: Blonde in the District Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Blonde in the District, an award winning Washington DC & Virginia life, style, beauty, and travel blog dedicated to body positivity and encouraging women to find their confidence through style.

feeds.title: Body Type
feeds.description: Examinations of body image discourse and body culture. Plus: How to feel better in and about your own body.

feeds.title: Dances With Fat Blog
feeds.description: I started this blog when I was competing in partner dancing. I keep blogging because there are people who hate themselves and their bodies because they don't think they have another choice, and because there are people who diet only because they think it's the only way to pursue health or happiness. My goal is and has always been to let as many people as possible know about the options of Size Acceptance and Health at Every Size.

feeds.title: Adios Barbie
feeds.description: A feminist site whose mission was to broaden the concepts of body image to include race, gender, LGBTQ, dis/ability, age, and size. Also about intersectionality, and radical self-acceptance. And while that's a mouthful, we believe that body image, like identity, happens in the mind. In fact, a person's body image has very little to do with one's actual body. Rather, it comes from external influences, beliefs, habits and conversations

feeds.title: CeCe Olisa Blog
feeds.description: CeCe Olisa is named one of the 'Top 10 New York Fashion Bloggers' by WhoWhatWear and a 'person who proves you can be fit at any size' by MTV.com, CeCe Olisa is co-Founder of theCURVYcon, a convention celebrating body positivity and plus size fashion during New York Fashion Week.

feeds.title: Stephanie Yeboah Blog
feeds.description: Stephanie has been an active presence within the influencer space; writing and creating content surrounding a variety of subjects including plus-size fashion, beauty, travel and lifestyle.

feeds.title: The Body Positive Blog
feeds.description: The Body Positive is a lively, healing community that offers freedom from suffocating societal messages that keep people in a perpetual struggle with their bodies. The Body Positive teaches people how to overcome the conflicts they have with their bodies so they can lead happier, more productive lives.

feeds.title: My Name Is Jessamyn
feeds.description: Jessamyn Stanley is a queer body positive cook, writer, and yoga enthusiast based in Durham, North Carolina. She rambles about yoga, health, and body image on her blog.

feeds.title: Karen R. Koenig Blog » Body Image
feeds.description: Read brief, to-the-point, conversational articles packed with information, strategies, and tips to turn troubled eaters into 'normal' eaters and to help you enjoy a happier, healthier life. Karen R. Koenig, LCSW, M.Ed., is a licensed psychotherapist, motivational speaker and international author who helps troubled individual reprogram their food routine for a better life.

feeds.title: Back On Track Teens Blog » Body Image
feeds.description: Discover the importance of self-love and respect and how to overcome Body Image issues in our Body Image article series. Back On Track Teens is a social empowerment program helping young people to identify who they are and discover their natural strengths and talents to live life in 'flow'.

feeds.title: IME Community » Body Positivity
feeds.description: Enjoy and learn expert guidance regarding Body Positivity and Self-love. Get Diet tips and Ideas that will help bring about a wholesome, uplifting change in your Body attitude and overall lifestyle. IME is a community for teens to achieve their goals and make a mark in the world through weight and life coaching.

feeds.title: Body Positive Alliance Blog
feeds.description: Read perspectives and opinions studying, critiquing, and exploring unhealthy body standards. Body Positive Alliance is a student-led non-profit organization that spreads body positivity at various levels through all-ages programming. We offer a place for people to explore topics related to the body-positive movement.

feeds.title: Amarachi Ukachu
feeds.description: Amarachi aims to help all women look and feel great in the clothes they wear, better than anyone else. Her inspirational posts make you feel confident in your own skin.

feeds.title: Glitter And Lazers Blog
feeds.description: I've been a fearless fashion obsessed for as long as I can remember. I am a travel addict; those who know me best call me the plus size Carmen San Diego. I never let my size or others' opinions of me keep me from living life to the fullest. I'm also an accomplished global speaker

feeds.title: Rosie Molinary Blog
feeds.description: As a radical self-acceptance champion, Rosie Molinary, MFA, uses profound questions and wholehearted connection to empower people to treat themselves well so they can connect with their talents and passions to authentically and intentionally live their purpose and help heal the world.

feeds.title: Cultivate the Curves
feeds.description: Cultivate the Curves by Latasha Gaines offers advice and inspiration on the topic of Body Positivity. Find clothing tips, motivations, and other useful resources. Latasha is the owner of Pleasantly Natural BodZ, a brand that encourages women to embrace their bodies as they are, regardless of their appearance, and emphasize positiveness.

feeds.title: Compared to Who? Blog
feeds.description: This is the place to start for women with Christian Body Image Issues. I'm a Jesus following mom who wants to see women improve their body image and find freedom from comparison! Be a part of a community of Christian women supporting each other with Gospel truth.
